2105-3499-4598-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3499-4598-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3499-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1981-2415-3899-8175.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Edgar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

1429-5958-8095.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-5958-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2073-5226-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

1619-2438-4605-5542-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6135.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Aarakocra Sneak from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Aarakocra Sneak token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Aarakocra Sneak trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6135.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4478-4644-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

338-4659-4772-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-4659-4772-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

1305-7009-7012.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1305-7009-7012.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk. Choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability given to it by Barbara Wright.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

2821-5479-6006-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte by remove a charge counter from it, untapping Minamo.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

277-1669-3293-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
277-1669-3293-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Tiller Engine trigger that many times.
Resolve all Tiller Engine triggers, untapping each land that entered.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
277-1669-3293-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

567-3197-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-3197-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-2060-5231-6701.description:
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1263-2060-5231-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

632-955-2034-3621-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-955-2034-3621-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

411-1283-2440.description:
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {3}.
When Grinning Ignus enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {1} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2100-6259.notablePrerequisites: Your speed is at least X.
392-2100-6259.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Searing Touch.
Repeat.

2351-4639--81.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate the Vehicle by tapping a blue creature you control except Unctus with power 1 or greater.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Vehicle's crew ability.
Repeat.

751-1418-1741.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
751-1418-1741.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Holding priority, activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning it and Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2099-2558-4848-5687.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Domri, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1909-4486-5845.notablePrerequisites: Orochi Merge-Keeper does not have summoning sickness, and is modified.
1909-4486-5845.description:
Activate Orochi Merge-Keeper by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Repeat.

3484-4374-4753.notablePrerequisites:
Clever Impersonator is a copy of Decoction Module.
{E}{E} available.
3484-4374-4753.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Decoction Module and Clever Impersonator, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

2232-2459-2837-5270.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
2232-2459-2837-5270.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Samwise Gamgee's first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

803-2178-4170-4302.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Fain.
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
"Angel" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2178-4170-4302.description:
Activate Fain's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability and Fain trigger.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, putting two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Repeat.

511-851-2034-3517.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with at least three spore counters on it.
511-851-2034-3517.description:
Activate a creature you control by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
The Saprolings enter the battlefield, triggering Tainted Observer twice.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve both Tainted Observer triggers, causing you to pay {4} to put two spore counters on any creature you control.
Repeat.

49-914-1799-4050.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
49-914-1799-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {1}.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then onto the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

3360-3430-4474.description:
Equip Paradise Mantle onto Torchling.
Tap Torchling to add {R}{R}{R}.
Spend that mana to untap Torchling.
Repeat.
